name: Speaking In Tongues
overview: The Scriptures reveal that speaking in tongues is a sign that follows those who believe in Christ, as Jesus promised that believers would speak with new tongues (Mark 16:17). This gift was powerfully demonstrated on the day of Pentecost when the believers, filled with the Holy Spirit, spoke in other tongues as the Spirit enabled them, causing a diverse crowd to hear the gospel in their own languages (Acts 2:1, 2:4, 2:6). Furthermore, speaking in tongues is associated with magnifying God, as seen in the experience of the early believers in Cornelius' household (Acts 10:46). This biblical phenomenon underscores the Spirit's role in empowering the church for global evangelism and worship.
